verdict.rationale: Bento documents visual workflows with triggers, branches, and delays, and it can preview branches before they run. The pack has no evidence that an ops user can see which step an individual person is on, or pull them out of or re-enter them into a running automation. The nearest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself: importing subscribers without triggering automations, and automatic segment membership.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
